hearth.note: loops; an opaque backdrop for the arch behind the sword

sparks.note: when a part goes into a slot, at the slot

hammer_strike.note: on the anvil face when a part goes in; plays sparks at the impact itself

steam.note: quench steam at the blade base when forging completes

forged_banner.note: stamps in over the sword, hold the last frame

heat_<blade id>.note: draw exactly over the blade's forge image: white-hot cooling through orange and red to steel, tip first. Sockets stay clear.

shine_<blade id>.note: a glint sweeping from the guard up to the tip, ending in a star; play after the heat strip

hearth_still.png.note: single frame of the hearth; use this, not the loop, so the forge stays readable

heat_halo.png.note: soft warm glow behind the sword while forging; centre it on the sword, slightly above the guard, and pulse its alpha

forge_complete_sequence: 0.00 s: hammer_strike on the anvil (or skip it if a part strike just played)
0.10 s: heat_<blade> over the blade (8 frames at 10 fps) and steam from the base of the blade (10 frames at 12 fps)
0.20 s: forged_banner over the sword top (6 frames, hold the last), light screen shake 2 px
